protocol.model_observation: board PNG, fixed rules, last six arrow keys
protocol.scope: exploratory game demo; not a computer-use benchmark or calibrated success probability

move.instructions: Which arrow-key move is best for this board? Choose one direction.

criteria.up: Press the UP arrow: slide every tile toward the top edge.
criteria.down: Press the DOWN arrow: slide every tile toward the bottom edge.
criteria.left: Press the LEFT arrow: slide every tile toward the left edge.
criteria.right: Press the RIGHT arrow: slide every tile toward the right edge.

scope: Exploratory live image/action runs, not a matched JEV benchmark. No model training.
export_note: Per-run scores and every decision are preserved. Transient session URLs and temporary image paths are omitted; SHA-256 identifies each PNG. Board arrays are evaluation records, never model inputs. Response calibration flags describe the unchanged existing checkpoint and do not establish gameplay calibration.

runner.timing_note: No discarded warmups; first model call may be cold for this shape. HTTP steps exclude the separate frame download; loop wall time includes evidence downloads and file writes.

events.request_text: Play the 2048 game shown in the attached board image. Choose the next arrow key. Tiles slide to that edge, adjacent equal tiles merge once, and a new tile then appears. Aim to reach 2048 by combining equal tiles and preserving empty spaces. Avoid a direction that leaves the board unchanged. Read the tile values and positions from the image.
